definitions.explanation: An artificial body of water created to store water for drinking, irrigation, or industrial use. May refer to large outdoor reservoirs or smaller storage facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{貯水池|ちょすいち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: This reservoir supports the city's water supply.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{貯水池|ちょすいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水位|すいい}→水位：21569_suii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がっている→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: The water level in the reservoir has dropped due to the lack of rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{貯水池|ちょすいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦{説明会|せつめいかい}→説明会：03087_setsumeikai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Plans for building a new reservoir were announced at a residents' meeting.

notes:
USAGE:
A technical but commonly encountered word in news about water supply, drought, and infrastructure. Often mentioned in weather reports during dry seasons.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {貯水池|ちょすいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水位|すいい}→水位：21569_suii⟧ (reservoir water level)
- {貯水池|ちょすいち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容量|ようりょう}→容量：04887_youryou⟧ (reservoir capacity)
- {貯水池|ちょすいち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧ (to maintain a reservoir)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ダム→ダム：00034_damu⟧: dam — the structure itself that creates a reservoir
- ⟦{溜|た}め{池|いけ}→溜め池：29726_tameike⟧: irrigation pond — a smaller, traditional pond for agricultural water storage
